newsitem.title: UK: LME copper hits six-week lows in inter-office trad.
newsitem.headline: LME copper hits six-week lows in inter-office trad.

text.p: Copper prices hit their lowest level since mid-May during London Metal Exchange evening inter-office business as the wave of liquidation that hit the market late afternoon continued.
Three months delivery traded down to around $2,410 at 1800 GMT. This compared with last afternoon business at $2,437 and Monday's close of $2,511 a tonne.

Traders said it appeared that market sentiment was looking a little tired after the recent slowing of upward momentum. A narrowing in the cash/threes spread to $110/$120 from around $140 earlier aided the trend.
Zinc and aluminium also extended afternoon losses with last evening business around $1,390 and $1,562 to be $7 and $15 under the afternoon kerb close.
